 Pennsatucky From Orange Is the New Black Is the Voice of Vicki in GTA VI
 Bethany Gemmell 2026년 11월 21일 토 오전 2:22 UTC 0 (Albert L. Ortega / Getty Images) If you’re one of millions currently playing Grand Theft Auto VI right now following its record-breaking launch this week, you will likely already have come across the character Vicki.
 Vicki, a Starlet Motel resident and stripper at the Delights club, is introduced to players during “Just Moved In.” Lucia purchases fake painkillers from Vicki for Jason during the “Girls Trip” mission and later becomes a recurring character during Chapter 2. 
 Vicki is voiced by Taryn Manning , best known for her role as Tiffany “Pennsatucky” Doggett on the early Netflix hit Orange Is the New Black . Pennsatucky, a proud self-proclaimed “redneck”, is imprisoned for shooting a nurse at an abortion clinic for making a joke about her frequency at the clinic. 
 After she receives a wave of support from anti-abortion activists, Manning’s character adopts a born-again Christian persona in an attempt to lighten her sentence, before adopting the faith during her time incarcerated.
 Advertisement
 Pennsatucky is one of the main antagonists in the first season of Orange Is the New Black , and Manning, who was offered the part without auditioning, was bumped up from recurring to main cast for the remainder of the show’s seven-season run, receiving critical acclaim.
 Manning is also known for her roles on high-profile shows, such as Mary Ann McGarrett on Hawaii Five-O, Cherry in Sons of Anarchy  seasons 1-3, and Rebecca Peabody in the Y2K teen series Get Real . The 48-year-old also appeared in several famous music videos, such as Nickelback’s “Rockstar” and Train’s “50 Ways to Say Goodbye.” 
 Manning’s best-known film credits include Hustle & Flow (2005), 8 Mile (2002), and the titular role in the racial horror-thriller film Karen (2021). She also appeared as herself in the TV shows America’s Next Top Model , Worst Cooks in America , Hollywood Medium with Tyler Henry , and Hollywood Game Night .
 Grand Theft Auto VI players may also recognize Manning’s voice from the song “Send Me Your Love,” featuring Sultan + Ned Shepard , which topped the Billboard Dance Club Songs chart in 2012.
